title: I finally saw Happiness (1998) expecting not to appreciate it, but did.

commenti.body:
Made it 15 minutes.  Awful and gratutitous.  Don't need to see characters blow their load or take a dump on screen.

Director was just a different flavor of Neil Labute, where they seem edgy and interesting for a bit, then it just devolves into one note wallowing.
So I take ut youre a fan of John Waters then?

Never seen anything by Waters so I can't comment.  I am familiar with the descreptions of his work and the themes.

LaBute it was In The Company Of Men.  Interesting on the first watch, lost interest when I realized it was the only thing LaBute had to say.  Did watch Nurse Betty, I would give that a thumbs up, but he didn't write it.

Welcome To The Dollhouse was good but got gratuitous and false at the end so I'd knock it down a bit.  Don't need to rewatch that.
How would you know what it devolves into if you've only seen 15 minutes?
There was a particularly gratuitous and unnecessary cutaway in this movie.  It wasn't the first thing but that was enough for me.  Life and time are precious.

It's a great movie. The humor is brutal and extremely dark, and it's surprisingly moving in a strange way too. It's the epitome of the idea that we all live lives of quiet desperation.
It doesn't compromise and has the balls to go places other movies would not dare.
I could not disagree with you more. It's a great movie.
